messages:
sre-bot: [ALERT] Container crashloop detected: runtime-engine v2.3 on node gpu-cluster-12. Crash count = 32 in 6m. Paging oncall: @oncall-dan

oncall-dan: got the page, i'm looking now. any immediate customer impact?

maria: seeing elevated 503s to /v1/generate from customer Ampli that line up with the crash timestamps.

kevin: logs show SIGSEGV in libengine.so::dispatch_kernel. GPU memory doesn't look saturated, not a typical OOM.

oncall-dan: ok grabbing logs + core if available. lisa, can you try kubectl logs -p and check /var/lib/crash or /dev/shm?

lisa: pulled previous pod core -> /tmp/core-1719995432.core.gz. running gdb for a quick bt.

lisa: ```
# gdb --batch -ex "thread apply all bt" --core /tmp/core-1719995432.core /opt/runtime/bin/engine
#0  0x00007f3a9b1a2f3c in engine::launch_kernel(void*) from /opt/runtime/lib/libengine.so
#1  0x00007f3a9b2c41aa in fused_attention::forward at fused_attn.cpp:342
#2  0x00007f3a9b3d11ff in vllm::run at infer.cpp:187
```

lisa: backtrace points to a null deref in launch_kernel -> likely use-after-free or missing device-side pointer check.

emily: node shows driver update last night (nvidia-driver 535.12). could be a regression but backtrace rooted in libengine.

kevin: suggestion: cordon the node and reschedule workloads off gpu-cluster-12. then run a canary with a patched runtime build on separate pool. draining now might cause churn but safer than letting more crashes hit customers.

oncall-dan: agree. plan: 1) cordon node 2) scale down risky model replicas (pin) 3) deploy runtime:2.3.1-hotfix as canary on stable pool 4) drain node after canary stable. who can cordon now?

maria: i'll notify CS and start customer comms for Ampli (latency spike).

kevin: i'll gather dmesg and kernel logs, checking for NVRM Xid messages. also capture /proc/driver/nvidia/version.

lisa: dmesg tail shows repeated entries: "NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 170, PID 12345" but no full kernel panic. points to device error during kernel launch.

oncall-dan: cordoning node gpu-cluster-12 now.

infra-bot: node/gpu-cluster-12 cordoned by oncall-dan at 1719995520.

emily: deploying canary runtime:2.3.1-hotfix -> pool stable-gpus (2 replicas). healthchecks enabled.

oncall-dan: running smoke tests against canary endpoints.

emily: canary passed 2m health checks, no crashes observed.

kevin: good. recommend rollout with maxUnavailable=1 across GPU pool. monitor 15m.

oncall-dan: initiating rollout now. watching logs and 5xx rate.

maria: CS update sent to Ampli: "We detected a transient runtime crashloop affecting some requests. We've cordoned an affected node and are rolling a patched runtime; mitigation in progress. No data loss reported." (INC-2026-2045)

lisa: uploading core to s3 for postmortem: s3://redwood-core-dumps/1719995432-core.gz

oncall-dan: after ~12m into rollout, crash events outside gpu-cluster-12 have dropped from 28/min to 0-1/min. system looks stable. keeping node cordoned for deeper RCA.

kevin: I'll take lead on instrumentation and sanitizer builds with eng-ml and runtime teams. tagging lisa for core analysis.

oncall-dan: handing off full RCA + customer follow-up to @kevin (next oncall). I'm closing active pager for now.

kevin: acknowledged, will run memory sanitizers and coordinate hotfix validation tomorrow.

sre-bot: Pager closed by oncall-dan at 1719995920. Incident thread archived. :white_check_mark:
